methodology: Questions and gold authored from parser bodies before running retrieval comparison. Each gold parent has a verbatim body quote, chunk ID and source path. No retrieved ranking used to set gold.
limitations: Not independently human-reviewed; domain expert review needed before treating metrics as a production acceptance gate.
Small development benchmark, not a held-out test set. 23 of 36 source files referenced as gold.
Six multi_format questions count three physical copies of the same decree as distinct relevant parents. Parent-level recall measures file retrieval, not unique legal content recall.
Four multi_document questions are explicit conjunctions requiring both named documents.
No unanswerable queries or chunk-level answer-span evaluation included.
